page.layout: One engraved title plate: a central oval scene framed by a cartouche, with four lines of printed text set in the upper and lower corners of the frame (upper left and right, then lower left and right). Below the plate, two putti and an ornamented pedestal.
page.notes: Title plate (engraving), no printed page number, running head or signature. The printed words are arranged around the oval: upper left "TRIBV" and upper right "SPE", then left "LAT" and right "S", then left "IO"; lower left "TO", right "IN"; lower left "LER", right "VI"; lower left "ANTIA", right "DIA". Read in sequence, the words are TRIBULATIO, SPES, TOLERANTIA, INVIDIA. The U of TRIBULATIO is printed as V and is transcribed as u in the words; the lines above keep the printed split, which is why the V appears in the upper line. The engraving shows a seated figure with a book or tablet, a standing figure with a torch or flame, a female figure at an altar with a flaming vessel, and a figure at the left holding a club-like object. Two putti flank the pedestal below. The engraving is not transcribed.
